content.title: Omnicell (NASDAQ:OMCL) Reports Bullish Q3, Stock Soars
content.summary: Healthcare tech company Omnicell (NASDAQ:OMCL) reported Q3 CY2025 results beating Wall Street’s revenue expectations, with sales up 10% year on year to $310.6 million. On top of that, next quarter’s revenue guidance ($311 million at the midpoint) was surprisingly good and 5.2% above what analysts were expecting. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.51 per share was 40.7% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

content.title: Omnicell: Q3 Earnings Snapshot
content.summary: On a per-share basis, the Fort Worth, Texas-based company said it had profit of 12 cents. Earnings, adjusted for stock option expense and amortization costs, came to 51 cents per share. The results surpassed Wall Street expectations.
